## Research focus

This paper explores Hadoop-based distributed data processing and introduces
machine-learning analysis with Apache Mahout. Its example investigates book
publication patterns across authors' age groups and calendar years, connecting
scalable storage and processing to an applied analysis task.

I am the first-listed author, alongside Sree Harsha Ravilla and Doina Bein. The
work is part of my background in distributed systems and data analysis.
